envelope.common: Keep existing literal/source/identity/state fields; scoringEligible literalfalse; strict no extra/local authority/persistable/model fields.
envelope.requirements: All existing item fields plus mapping and tokenEvidence. Literal value never replaced by canonical label. derivation exact, confidence value null, all offsets/minimumYears integerbounded. mapping null for non-skills, registered alias/exact/unmapped for skills.
envelope.relations: Object with clauses only. Each clause exact id(lowercaseSHA),evidence,reviewRequired:true,scope{importance,negated},skillExpression,duration,prospectiveCreditGroups,numericCredit:null. No local scope authority.
envelope.expressions: Same A08 atom/any_of/all_of/unknown tagged grammar and exact operator/operand evidence; never flatten groups.
envelope.durations: Same A08 typed kind/evidence/lower/upper/operator/candidate/reason, integer0-100 inclusive bounds, literal_clause_only and evaluated:false. Unsupported/mixed/inverted/negated/ambiguous forms remain explicit unknown.
envelope.warnings: Preserve deterministic source warnings/ambiguities/reasons, within reviewed bounded schema; do not silently truncate. Stored producer remains review-only and non-scoring. The retained local_alias_policy_not_admitted code is source-discovery/scoring-adoption status; persistent review admission does not grant taxonomy or numerical adoption.

unicode.wellformed: Reject NUL and unpaired surrogates; preserve raw Unicode, no NFC/NFKC. Quote offsets codepoints; limit lengths UTF16units.
unicode.metadata: Pin actual Node22/Unicode/ICU/rule profile and exact data hash; reject unsupported write-runtime drift.
unicode.parity: Separate L/N/M identifier sets, alias dollar/underscore/asymmetricdot, duration boundary, JS regex-word iu, whitespace/trim, default lowercase inclFinalSigma and relevant Unicode regex case-folds. Never substitute PG locale lower/word/space class.
unicode.policyBinding: Stored producer1.0.0 registers exact profile and codec in immutable admission descriptor used by TS and SQL. Descriptor hash includes alias/relation hashes and Unicode profile. No caller policy override.

semanticProjection.include: All source/scope/producer/policy/state/warning/ambiguity/mapping/quote/OR-AND/duration/inclusive/unknown interpretation content. Owner/org/analysis/job IDs remain authority bindings.
semanticProjection.ordering: Requirements sorted start,end,type,value with UTF8 byte tie order; reject duplicate observation keys. Map requirementIDs to /requirements/<ordinal> in all references; reject dangling/duplicate/cross-kind refs and sort refs byordinal. Clauses/retainedclauses byspan; token/candidate spans byposition; operands/operators stay sourceorder; uniquecredit hashes lexical. Warnings/reasons keep registered deterministic order.
semanticProjection.spanId: Validate exact jd-<start>-<end> before excluding redundant field.
semanticProjection.encoding: Recursive sorted fixedASCII object keys, no structural whitespace, UTF8 JSON; integers decimal(-0/1.0 canonical0/1), exact JSON.stringify string escapes inclcontrol lowercasehex, preserve nonBMP andU2028/U2029, no slash escaping.
